items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Did you have Nappy and Rene in the band at the same time? ... No, no, no. Rene left to go to Tulane. He went to take up architecture and that's when Nappy took his place.

ctx.x: That was... We went over there, that's when we got Hilton Lamar and we got... Who else? I believe that was the only one that... Yeah, Rene went... Rene Jalopy went to the Tudeling.
That's when Earl was starting to learn how to read and they were playing some overture and he went to...
